headline: Energy and Defence Stocks Slide Post-Midterms; Petrobras and YPF Decline
summary: Defence and oil shares dropped while hospital stocks gained following the US midterm elections. Latin American producers Petrobras and YPF led declines among oil equities.
why: Shifts in US congressional control often alter policy expectations for fossil fuels, healthcare subsidies, and defence procurement.

impacts.name: Petrobras
impacts.why: Petrobras fell sharply as energy equities came under pressure following the Democratic victory in Congress.
